about: THE LANTERN: the opening cinematic's narration (docs/abyssal-tether-3d/plans/OPENING_V2_THE_COLLAR.md section 6.1).
Same format as performance.json `lines` (take = phrases, pauses in ms, {in} breaths, *stress*); the cast (voice blends) is performance.json's.
max_s = the line's slot in the timeline (src/sim/openingCinematic.js VO): the take is fitted inside it.

Rendered by tools/abyssal-tether-3d/voice/build_opening_vo.py to public/abyssal-tether-3d/assets/audio/opening/<id>.ogg, dry; the game gives the team's briefing lines (VO fx 'radio') the console speaker's colour at play time.

op-11.speaker: ODESSA
op-11.text: The team's all here, Elias. The Lighters are four hours behind you.
op-11.moment: THE COLLAR: the cold station, the drones on their pads (from the console speaker: v2)
op-11.emotion: warm, unhurried, a day she has opened before

take.t: The Lighters are four hours behind you.

op-12.speaker: ODESSA
op-12.text: Your job is small. Go down to Lamp Zero, clear the ring points, and wait.
op-12.moment: THE COLLAR: the rotors spin up

take.t: Go down to Lamp Zero, clear the ring points,

op-13.speaker: TICK
op-13.moment: THE MEASURE: the four drones latch on

op-14.speaker: VESPER
op-14.moment: THE MEASURE: the scan line sweeps him, head to boots (the Dresser chalk, word for word)

op-15.speaker: TICK
op-15.text: Got you. Head to boots, to the millimetre.
op-15.moment: THE HALL: the empty chair; the drones take the weight

op-16.speaker: VESPER
op-16.text: Work order confirmed. Payload one. Return zero.
op-16.moment: THE IRIS: the iris opens under the cradle (only makes sense on a replay)

op-4.speaker: ODESSA
op-4.text: Five hundred and fifty-six metres of cut stone. Every probe we lowered went quiet at the bottom.
op-4.moment: THE IRIS: the cradle sinks into the shaft under its four drones
take: Five hundred and fifty-six metres of cut stone.

op-5.speaker: ODESSA
op-5.text: So we are lowering a person.
op-5.moment: THE IRIS -> THE WINDOW: the cradle far below, its lantern lit, nobody in it

op-1.speaker: MAREN
op-1.text: Seventeen ninety-one. One woman climbed out of this shaft, carrying a flame.
op-1.moment: THE WINDOW: the cradle passes the Outer Dark
take: One woman climbed out of this shaft,

op-17.speaker: TICK
op-17.text: Five metres. Three. Lamp Zero's right under your boots.
op-17.moment: LAMP ZERO: reading the altimeter as the cradle comes down

take.t: Lamp Zero's right under your boots.

op-18.speaker: TICK
op-18.text: That's as deep as they go. Drones heading home.
op-18.moment: THE RELEASE: the drones let go and climb away
take: That's as deep as they go.

op-6.speaker: MAREN
op-6.text: They carved one rule over the door.
op-6.moment: THE RELEASE: the drones climb away, their lights dying

take.t: They carved *one* rule over the door.

op-7.speaker: MAREN
op-7.text: Trust the ring, not the floor. The floor keeps.
op-7.moment: THE DOOR: the push to the plaque over the empty cradle

op-8.speaker: MAREN
op-8.text: The record says something was down here before the lamp.
op-8.moment: shot 6 THE KNOCK: after the third knock, the flame leans

op-9.speaker: MAREN
op-9.text: Before the first stone was cut. Something we never prepared for.
op-9.moment: shot 7 BEFORE THE LAMP: eyes in the well

take.t: Before the first stone was cut.

op-10.speaker: MAREN
op-10.moment: shot 7: the lunge; the game cuts the line with static
